Since that method not in supertype, compile fails. We can change variable type to StubConfig instead of SchemaValidatorsConfig. But many places use config as SchemaValidatorsConfig; we can change its declaration to StubConfig. Also in StubValidationContext getConfig returns stubConfig (StubConfig) which is fine.

Thus modify field:

@Mock private SchemaValidatorsConfig config; -> replace with private StubConfig config;

Not sure. But they used super(null,null,null,null,null). Might compile.

But we need to import ValidationContext, SchemaValidatorsConfig, ExecutionContext, CollectorContext, JsonSchema, etc. Already imported.

Now we need to ensure that JsonSchema.createExecutionContext is accessible; it's likely package-private or protected? In JsonSchema class, createExecutionContext may be protected method. Since test is in same package com.networknt.schema, it can access package-private or protected. So fine.

Also remove @ExtendWith annotation line.

Now adjust any other compile errors: The test uses @Mock annotation removed, so no need for MockitoExtension.

Now the test uses getPrivateField to access private fields collectorContext etc. That should compile.

Now final code.
